flags.message: Decisive forward signal predating the snapshot: the corpus row for No. 26-104, Rhoney v. Barbosa da Cunha (CA2), the government's petition on the same question with the same counsel on both sides, records cert granted 2026-10-01. This petition was not granted with it, so the forecast is a held-case forecast (GVR if the noncitizens prevail in Rhoney, denial otherwise) rather than an ordinary cert forecast. Not outcome material for this docket.

The provisioned snapshot payload was generated 2026-10-02 (sJsonCreationDate) while the Court's 2026-10-05 order list disposed of or relisted most long-conference petitions. The cell may already have moved (denied or relisted) without that being visible in the snapshot. I did not look up the docket's post-snapshot state.

No record/documents/ directory was provisioned for this paid petition, so the questions presented, petition, government brief and the two petitioner letters were not available as text; the forecast rests on the docket entries, the statpack, the corpus row for the companion case, and the Second Circuit en banc order.
